WITH engine_totals AS (
  SELECT engine, COUNT(*) AS total_answers
  FROM answers
  GROUP BY engine
)
SELECT a.engine,
       a.winner AS competitor,
       COUNT(*) AS frequency,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / et.total_answers, 1) AS share_pct
FROM answers a
JOIN engine_totals et ON a.engine = et.engine
WHERE a.winner <> 'Kurta Co'
GROUP BY a.engine, a.winner, et.total_answers
ORDER BY a.engine, frequency DESC;

WITH engine_totals AS (
  SELECT engine, COUNT(*) AS total_answers
  FROM GLISPER_DEMO.answers
  GROUP BY engine
)
SELECT a.engine,
       a.winner AS competitor,
       COUNT(*) AS frequency,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / et.total_answers, 1) AS share_pct
FROM GLISPER_DEMO.answers a
JOIN engine_totals et ON a.engine = et.engine
WHERE a.winner <> 'Kurta Co'
GROUP BY a.engine, a.winner, et.total_answers
ORDER BY a.engine, frequency DESC LIMIT 200

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT a.result_id, a.run_date, a.engine, a.status
  FROM answers a
  WHERE a.winner <> 'Kurta Co'
),
answer_domains AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.result_id, f.run_date, f.engine, f.status, s.domain
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN answer_sources s
    ON f.result_id = s.result_id
   AND f.run_date = s.run_date
   AND f.engine = s.engine
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    engine,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_won,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_not_won
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT result_id, run_date, engine, status FROM filtered) t
  GROUP BY engine
),
domain_stats AS (
  SELECT
    engine,
    domain,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won_citations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_won_citations
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT result_id, run_date, engine, status, domain FROM answer_domains) d
  GROUP BY engine, domain
)
SELECT
  ds.engine,
  ds.domain,
  ROUND(100.0 * ds.not_won_citations / t.total_not_won, 1) AS not_won_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * ds.won_citations / t.total_won, 1) AS won_pct
FROM domain_stats ds
JOIN totals t ON ds.engine = t.engine
WHERE t.total_not_won > 0 AND t.total_won > 0
ORDER BY ds.engine, not_won_pct DESC, won_pct ASC;

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT a.result_id, a.run_date, a.engine, a.status
  FROM GLISPER_DEMO.answers a
  WHERE a.winner <> 'Kurta Co'
),
answer_domains AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.result_id, f.run_date, f.engine, f.status, s.domain
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN GLISPER_DEMO.answer_sources s
    ON f.result_id = s.result_id
   AND f.run_date = s.run_date
   AND f.engine = s.engine
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    engine,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_won,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_not_won
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT result_id, run_date, engine, status FROM filtered) t
  GROUP BY engine
),
domain_stats AS (
  SELECT
    engine,
    domain,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won_citations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_won_citations
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT result_id, run_date, engine, status, domain FROM answer_domains) d
  GROUP BY engine, domain
)
SELECT
  ds.engine,
  ds.domain,
  ROUND(100.0 * ds.not_won_citations / t.total_not_won, 1) AS not_won_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * ds.won_citations / t.total_won, 1) AS won_pct
FROM domain_stats ds
JOIN totals t ON ds.engine = t.engine
WHERE t.total_not_won > 0 AND t.total_won > 0
ORDER BY ds.engine, not_won_pct DESC, won_pct ASC LIMIT 200

result.answer: Lahore Loom's weakest engine is Gemini, where it holds only 40.3% first‑place share (29 mentions) compared to 55.6% on Claude (40 mentions) and 61.1% on ChatGPT (44 mentions). On ChatGPT, answers where Lahore Loom does not win cite third‑party domains more heavily, notably dawn.com (50.0% of losses vs 43.2% of wins), daraz.pk (40.9% vs 38.6%), and youtube.com (36.4% vs 38.6%). Winning answers on ChatGPT always cite lahoreloom.pk (100% won, 0% not‑won).
